input.prompt:
In a single unbroken scene. No scene cuts. Slow gimbal move only. No subtitles. No captions. No lower thirds. No music. No dialogue. No sound effects.

16:9. 35mm lens, f/2.8, camera at table height. A real light-gray grooming studio, wall #E6E5E1. Large window key light from camera left, plus the glow of a wall sign. Soft contact shadows. No flash.

On the back wall, centered and fully inside the frame with space around every letter, a thin neon ribbon is mounted and glowing turquoise #0C6E78. The ribbon forms the complete word OXIGROOM in capital letters. All eight letters are readable for the whole clip: O, X, I, G, R, O, O, M. It is a physical sign on the wall, not a graphic overlay. The neon stays sharp and does not melt.

[0-4s] The camera drifts in across a pale gray grooming table. A real wet Yorkshire terrier lies on the table and looks straight into the lens. Tan facial hair is in separate damp strands, one water bead on the black nose. Only a groomer's forearms show: warm skin, short clean nails, turquoise cotton apron #0C6E78. The neon word OXIGROOM is already fully visible on the wall behind them.
[4-9s] The same shot continues without a cut. The hands lift a metal slicker comb. A cloud of cut cream undercoat hangs in the air and catches both the window and the turquoise neon. A gray tabby domestic shorthair cat sits at the right edge of the table, watches the dog, then slowly extends one paw toward a single floating tuft. The york's ear twitches. The camera keeps drifting. The wall sign still reads OXIGROOM.
[9-15s] The york gives one small shake. Fine droplets hang in the light. The cat draws its paw back. The camera eases back toward the opening angle so the clip can loop, and the york looks into the lens again. The neon ribbon still spells the full word OXIGROOM.

Photographed on a full-frame camera, 24fps, natural grain. Imperfect wet fur, visible skin, micro-detail in whiskers. Lived-in studio.
No CGI. No plastic fur. No 3D character. No beauty filter. No lineup of animals. No cropped letters. No extra words. No Cyrillic. No stethoscope. No pet shop. No cages. No price tags.
